name: answerrail-mcp
description: 6-category AI readiness, Schema.org JSON-LD, robots.txt AI bot rules, /llms.txt, Google Lighthouse 13.5 ARD 1.0 (ai-catalog.json), and 25,000-token price recall audit + local auto-fix MCP server.
author: The Quite Good Project

tools.name: audit_local_codebase_and_generate
tools.description: Scans local codebase across 6 weighted categories (14+ robots.txt AI crawler rules, 20+ Schema.org JSON-LD types, /llms.txt, and ARD 1.0 /.well-known/ai-catalog.json) and writes compliant fix files locally.

tools.name: audit_ai_readiness
tools.description: Audits a live website URL or domain for AI crawler access, 25,000-token HTML RAG truncation, /llms.txt presence, Schema.org JSON-LD entities, and Google Lighthouse 13.5 Agentic Browsing (/.well-known/ai-catalog.json ARD 1.0).

tools.name: generate_ai_manifests
tools.description: Compiles ready-to-save /llms.txt documentation index and Google Lighthouse 13.5 /.well-known/ai-catalog.json (ARD 1.0) JSON manifests from a live domain.

tools.name: extract_byte0_markdown
tools.description: Strips React/Next.js hydration scripts and DOM bloat from any URL, returning clean Byte-0 GitHub-Flavored Markdown (GFM) with front-loaded Schema.org tables.

tools.name: query_truncation_benchmark
tools.description: Retrieves empirical benchmark telemetry from the 2026 50-Site SaaS & E-Commerce AI Truncation Study.
